parameters.content:
## W31 DM handler (community-response-lead, 4.14)

Trigger: Messenger and Instagram `messages` webhook (path /webhook/meta-dm). Flow: signature check (automation/security/verify-webhooks.js) -> load rules/corpus/prompt -> fetch first name -> upsert conversation -> route (STOP, human handoff, paused, age answer, classify) -> Haiku classify (strict JSON, fail closed to human) -> disclose + FAQ answer (Haiku draft, FAIS lint, shared guardrail) -> ONE age-band question (quick replies) -> CTWA link -> stop. The person typing person, human or manager hands off to Jonathan/KG and pauses the bot. STOP is honoured silently (suppression, no further message).

We only ever reply inside the 24-hour window after the person's last message (RESPONSE messaging type). Replies 07:00-22:00 SAST; overnight replies are written to dm_queue and sent from 07:15 if the window is still open (otherwise marked expired and nothing is sent). Nobody is DMed unless they commented (private reply) or messaged first. No reply from the person means nothing further.

Credentials by name: `LV Supabase - n8n_app (least privilege)`, `Meta Page Token`, `Anthropic API`. Alerts go to W22 by Execute Workflow smc-w22 (I-47g). Env: REPO_DIR, AUTOMATION_DIR, META_APP_SECRET, META_VERIFY_TOKEN, META_GRAPH_VERSION, CTWA_BASE_URL, CONSOLE_URL, N8N_INTERNAL_URL. Tables: dm_threads (channel, external_id, state, paused, opted_out, last_user_message_at; `conversations` is a per-message view, never written), dm_queue, escalations (assigned_agent text) (supabase/migrations/20261002060000_smc_06_pass2.sql). Ingress: Page `messaging` events forwarded from W02's page ingress and IG messages; forward the raw body with the original X-Hub-Signature-256 header.

DM text is never stored: only the conversation state (step, counts, age band) and the last message id are saved. Success runs are not saved.

## Env + runtime dependencies (I-31c)
`ESC_REAL_KINDS` (name only in automation/.env.example): unset or false = escalation kinds are mapped to the old constraint (`sensitive` -> `human_handoff`; `dm_handoff` and `dm_after_link` -> `dm`) and the real kind is kept in `kind_requested`; set `ESC_REAL_KINDS=true` once migration 08 (escalations_kind_check with sensitive, dm_handoff, dm_after_link) is applied on the target database. No workflow change needed.
`conversation/guardrail.mjs` is loaded in the guardrail Code nodes with `require('lv-automation').guardrail` (I-44a: the one allowlisted package, `NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_EXTERNAL=lv-automation`, linked to the read-only repo mount; automation/index.cjs). If it cannot load, the gate fails closed (`classifier_input_unavailable` -> fixed template), so a broken mount silences replies rather than sending unchecked text.

parameters.query: insert into dm_threads (brand_id, channel, external_id, state, last_user_message_at) values ((select b.id from brands b where b.code = 'SMC'), $1, $2, '{}'::jsonb, now()) on conflict (channel, external_id) do update set last_user_message_at = now(), updated_at = now() returning state, paused, opted_out, (xmax = 0) as is_new
update dm_threads set updated_at = now(), opted_out = true, state = coalesce(state, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('stopped', true) where channel = $1 and external_id = $2
update dm_threads set state = $3::jsonb, paused = $4::boolean, updated_at = now() where channel = $1 and external_id = $2
insert into escalations (kind, ref_table, ref_id, raised_at, assigned_agent, note) values ($5, 'dm_threads', $2, now(), $3, $4 || '; kind_requested=' || $1) returning id

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $('Finalise DM').item.json.esc.kind_requested || $('Finalise DM').item.json.esc.kind, $('Finalise DM').item.json.channel + ':' + $('Finalise DM').item.json.sender_id, $('Finalise DM').item.json.esc.to.join(','), 'bot paused; first human touch within ' + $('Finalise DM').item.json.esc.human_within_seconds + 's', $('Finalise DM').item.json.esc.kind_stored || $('Finalise DM').item.json.esc.kind ] }}

parameters.query: insert into dm_queue (channel, external_id, owner_id, reply_text, quick_replies, window_expires_at, due_at, status) values ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5::jsonb, $6::timestamptz, $7::timestamptz, 'queued')

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $('Finalise DM').item.json.channel, $('Finalise DM').item.json.sender_id, $('Finalise DM').item.json.owner_id, $('Finalise DM').item.json.reply_text, JSON.stringify($('Finalise DM').item.json.quick_replies), $('Finalise DM').item.json.window_expires_at, $('Finalise DM').item.json.due_at ] }}

parameters.query: select id, channel, external_id as sender_id, owner_id, reply_text, quick_replies, window_expires_at from dm_queue where status = 'queued' and due_at <= now() order by created_at asc limit 40

parameters.jsCode: return $input.all().map((it) => { const r = it.json; const qr = typeof r.quick_replies === 'string' ? JSON.parse(r.quick_replies) : (r.quick_replies || []); return { json: { queue_id: r.id, channel: r.channel, owner_id: r.owner_id, sender_id: r.sender_id, reply_text: r.reply_text, quick_replies: qr, window_expires_at: new Date(r.window_expires_at).toISOString() } }; });

parameters.query: update dm_queue set status = 'expired' where id = $1::bigint

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ recipient: { id: $json.sender_id }, messaging_type: 'RESPONSE', message: Object.assign({ text: $json.reply_text }, ($json.quick_replies && $json.quick_replies.length) ? { quick_replies: $json.quick_replies } : {}) }) }}

parameters.query: with upd as (update dm_queue set status = case when $6::boolean then 'sent' when attempts >= 2 then 'failed' else 'queued' end, attempts = attempts + 1, due_at = case when $6::boolean then due_at else now() + interval '10 minutes' end where id = $1::bigint returning id) insert into dm_queue (channel, external_id, owner_id, reply_text, quick_replies, window_expires_at, due_at, status) select $2, $3, $4, $5, $7::jsonb, $8::timestamptz, now() + interval '10 minutes', 'queued' where $1::bigint is null and not $6::boolean

// DRY_RUN_SENDS=true: nothing leaves the box (messenger). Pass the input on with a fake 2xx so downstream logging still runs.
return $input.all().map((i, n) => ({ json: { ...i.json, dry_run: true, statusCode: 200, body: { messages: [{ id: 'dry:' + n }] } } }));
